issue.title: Explicitly set all HTTP methods for Azure Functions
issue.body:
It appears that failure to do so results in the generated metadata not automatically including them (as opposed to what the javadoc of `@HttpTrigger` says)

- Fixes: #39242

body:
I can confirm this is still an issue in 3.8.2. 

`quarkus run` or deploying the function to azure functions with `quarkus deploy` will effectively push the function but you'll get a 404 due to the 'methods' field having an empty value in the generated function.json file.   When I remove this field altogether it works again.
Should we backport to the lts version perhaps?  It's broken in 3.8 now.
